affected.note: Theoretical maximum: all class of 2027 and 2028 students searchable on OfferBox while the misconfiguration existed (2026-05-12 to 2026-08-28). The data was only visible to client companies through browser developer tools, with names encoded as character codes; no leak to third parties other than client companies had been confirmed.

summary.en: i-plug said a configuration error in its job offer service OfferBox caused students' names and email addresses to be included in the communication data of a page for client companies, where they could be seen using browser developer tools. Up to 314,009 students who were searchable between 2026-05-12 and 2026-08-28 may have been affected.
summary.ja: i-plugは、新卒オファー型就活サービス「OfferBox」の設定不備により、利用企業向けページの通信データに学生の氏名とメールアドレスが含まれ、ブラウザの開発者ツールで閲覧できる状態だったと発表した。2026年5月12日から8月28日までに検索対象となっていた最大314,009人が対象となる可能性がある。

sources.title: 「OfferBox」システム設定不備に伴うお詫びとお知らせ
